title: Plan on one model, implement on another: opusplan with the halves remapped
description:
Per the map tickets 'Models per Stage' (harness-0sx.6) and 'Prototype: the /config modal' (harness-0sx.9, PLAN + IMPLEMENT as revised). Research: research/stage-models (docs/research/stage-models.md).

Implement's config row gains a plan model (unset: one model plans and implements). A split is a plan model other than Implement's named model, Implement on claude, both of one family (Anthropic). On a split Implement runs --model opusplan, and its --settings file (plan_settings) adds env ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=<plan model> and ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL=<implement model>, and showClearContextOnPlanAccept: true. The Harness approves the Plan with the 'Yes, clear context and …' option, moving the cursor to it by reading the dialog as send_back does, so the implementing model starts from the Plan alone. With no split: plain --model, and approval stays option 1, keeping the context. Implement's effort covers both halves. A split with Implement's model at default is refused where the config is read: the split needs a named model for each half.

A PostModelSwitch hook in Implement's settings logs 'implement switched to <model>' at approval, through a hidden mode like __plan-hook. RECENT's started line on a split: 'implement started: claude fable→opus/high'.

Live checks, unverified in the research, are the user's after this merges; do not run them in this session, and list them in the PR for the user: the model still switches after a clear-context approval (fallback: approve with option 1 and keep the context); aliases work in ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL (fallback: resolve the alias to a full id with a probe, whose JSON modelUsage names it); the PostModelSwitch hook's name and input.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Fake world: a split writes the env and showClearContextOnPlanAccept into the settings file, starts --model opusplan, and approves by moving to the clear-context option on a fake dialog screen; no split keeps plain --model and option 1; a split with Implement at default is refused; the hook's input logs the switched line. The PR lists the live checks for the user.
